topics.title_zh: 奥特曼称同情数学家但绝不收手：更多AI成果还在路上
topics.title_en: Sam Altman sympathizes with mathematicians, but says OpenAI’s math onslaught won’t stop
topics.summary_zh: 奥特曼回应AI成果压垮数学家一事，称虽抱有同情但绝不减速，并暗示储备了更多推导成果等待发布
topics.summary_en: During a podcast appearance, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman addressed the overwhelming influx of AI-generated proofs flooding the mathematics community, stating that while he sympathizes with researchers struggling to verify the barrage, OpenAI has no intention of slowing down. He further revealed that the company possesses a stockpile of new discoveries waiting to be released, defending the onslaught under the banner of advancing humanity's understanding of the universe.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 AGI加速派 / 前沿研究员
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 大模型推理架构师与前沿实验室团队
perspective_pro.point_zh: 大模型在长程推理与百年数学猜想探索中迈出了历史性一步，AI自探索与符号演绎展现了全新科学发现范式。
perspective_pro.point_en: Extended reasoning represents a historic step in exploring mathematical conjectures, opening a new paradigm for scientific discovery.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 严谨学界 / 理论数学家
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 数学家与形式化验证学者
perspective_con.point_zh: 论文正文存在大量逻辑断层与形式主义幻觉，用概率自相关拼凑严谨数理证明极具欺骗性，缺乏确定性严密结论。
perspective_con.point_en: The submission exhibits critical logical disconnects and formal hallucinations, failing to satisfy the rigorous standards of mathematical proof.

This release stems from the company's continuous exploration of more autonomous AI agent paradigms in vertical software development scenarios.
